name: reviews-platform-api
description: Reviews Platform API v42: pins Render/Node runtime to Node 22 LTS and adds deploy preflight checks for local require files while preserving Product Creation & Import editor.

scripts.check: npm run deploy:preflight && node scripts/verify-restore.js && node scripts/cart-rewards-smoke-test.js
scripts.deploy:preflight: node scripts/verify-relative-requires.js && node --check server.js && node --check src/app.js && find src public Shopify-Liquid/assets extensions/review-widget-extension/assets -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
